perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal paid search returned 20 results (4 URL/title overlaps with base). Incremental recall beyond the base providers consisted of the Filip minimax published PDF, a general approximation-theory lecture note, AAA slide deck, Chebfun sqrt/minimax demos, the Saff-Stahl ray-sequences paper, and the mandatory Filip dissertation. Every parked candidate with same object, shared parameters, terminology, original-paper, or highly relevant title was opened and inspected at body level (full-text parameter grep, section/table/example scan, or theorem-scope comparison). All are diagonal, asymptotic, different-function, or method-only sources: none states the rectangular E_{6,3}(|x|)<=0.02 threshold, lists the submitted coefficients, or implies the finite certificate (diagonal bounds run E_{6,6}<=E_{6,3} the wrong way). No COVERS_CLAIM source and no UNRESOLVED_CANDIDATE remain, so provisional originality PASS is preserved with no new decisive prior.
